item.title: Zebra Mildliner Highlighters
item.description:

One of the standout features of the Zebra Mildliners is their unique pastel colors. Unlike traditional highlighters that can create an overpowering look, the gentle hues of Mildliners not only enhance your text but also keep your notes looking clean and organized. This is perfect for students who want to maintain a polished appearance in their study materials, and for journalers who are keen on creativity and artistry in their planners.
